app.name: Victron VRM
app.summary: Your Victron sensors together on your Tessera screen.
app.reverse_battery_hint: Turn on if your mapped battery power sensor reports positive power when discharging.
app.reverse_grid_hint: Turn on if your mapped grid power sensor reports positive power when exporting.
app.max_age_hint: Only used with a mapped source timestamp. No timestamp means age unknown.
app.hint_source_time: Epoch seconds (not milliseconds or ISO text). Choose a sensor that timestamps this measurement set.
app.hint_soc: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: %. Values are not inferred from other sensors.
app.hint_battery: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: W, kW or MW. Values are not inferred from other sensors.
app.hint_solar: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: W, kW or MW. Values are not inferred from other sensors. Map a total of all your solar sources.
app.hint_load: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: W, kW or MW. Values are not inferred from other sensors. Map AC consumption power, not an energy meter in kWh.
app.hint_grid: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: W, kW or MW. Values are not inferred from other sensors. Optional for off-grid systems; positive means import by default.
app.hint_voltage: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: V or mV. Values are not inferred from other sensors.
app.hint_current: Choose an existing Home Assistant sensor. Unit: A or mA. Values are not inferred from other sensors.
